The canonical guidance for this repository is [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Read it
first; this file is only a short pointer.

This is the **GitHub profile repository** of Carmine Cuofano

`README.md` is the only rendered product.

Key points:

- The correct handle is `Giancarmine` (ends in **mine**); `giancarme` is not the account.
